 26 Best Toy Shops In Singapore With Educational & Trending Toys
 Posted on 29 October, 2026 | By Sassy Mama 
 Post Category - Family Life Family Life Post Category - Play Play 
 Post Category - Family Life Family Life Post Category - Play Play 
 Looking to upgrade your kids’ toys or pick up a subtly educational but fun-filled birthday present for the kids? Check out our guide to the best toy shops in Singapore!
 Whether you’re looking for a durable toy or a well-designed open-ended one, here are some of our favourite toy shops in Singapore! These stores are brimming with educational, entertaining, and most importantly, good quality toys. From STEM toys to hard-to-find LEGOs and diversity toys like multi-racial dolls , we let you know which toy shops are worth trekking to!
 While you’re at it, check out these baby shops in Singapore where you can find newborn baby gifts and hampers and 100-days and full-month gifts on top of plenty of toys! Looking for more gift ideas? Read our guide to finding the most adorable kids clothes and baby clothes in Singapore and kids swimwear and swimsuits in Singapore .
 The Better Toy Store: Safe & sustainable toys
 Image credit: The Better Toy Store via Instagram 
 With a name like The Better Toy Store, you can rest assured that you’re shopping for the very best toys when you spend your dollars here! The Better Toy Store are masters at selecting the highest quality toys that are safe and sustainable. They stock wooden toys, STEM toys and games that strive to educate and inspire young minds. We particularly love their gorgeous dollhouses, intricate train sets, and handmade puppets.
 The Better Toy Store, multiple locations in Singapore including Orchard, Dhoby Ghaut and Tanglin Road, www.thebettertoystore.com 
 My Toy Shop: LEGO galore & educational toys
 Image credit: My Toy Shop via Instagram 
 Founded by LEGO fanatics, My Toy Shop is a bottomless pit of every kid’s favourite building block–LEGO. This neighbourhood toy shop in Singapore is also brimming with an extensive range of games and other toys from brands like Hasbro, HotWheels, and Crayola. If you’re not a fan of whining-induced “I want it now” meltdowns, we’d definitely recommend leaving the munchkins at home before you head here…or shop online instead.
 My Toy Shop, 293 Holland Road, #02-11 Jelita Shopping Mall, Singapore 278628, www.mytoyshop.com.sg 
 Toys ‘R’ Us: Educational toys for kids of all ages
 Image credit: Toys R Us Singapore 
 Toys ‘R’ Us does have constant loud music, but if you’re looking for mainstream toy brands, you’ll find it at this toy galore. From LEGO to Minecraft, Nerf, Barbie, Crayola, Play Doh and more, they’ve got it all, making it a reliable toy shop in Singapore to visit for birthdays and present shopping. With so many toys to explore, it may be difficult to convince the kids to go home!
 Toys ‘R’ Us, multiple locations in Singapore including Punggol, Tampines and Orchard, www.toysrus.com.sg 
 Barefoot Toys: Toys that inspire imagination & play
 Image credit: Barefoot Toys via Instagram 
 Barefoot Toys is all about imagination and play! Inspired by the owners’ children and their innate sense of curiosity, fun, and adventure, this toy shop in Singapore offers a thoughtfully curated selection of quality toys that are safe, engaging, and fun. Plus, they also have a range of travel-friendly toys, which are handy for keeping the kids occupied while on the road or in the air!
 Barefoot Toys, www.barefoottoys.sg 
 Bricks World: LEGO toy shop in Singapore
 Image credit: Bricks World via Facebook 
 LEGO fans, rejoice! Bricks World is the go-to store for those who love building and creating with LEGOs. A LEGO-certified toy store in Singapore, Bricks World has all of the classic and latest building sets that would surely put a smile on the face of a kiddo who loves LEGOs!
 Bricks World,  multiple locations in Singapore including Orchard, Jurong East, Suntec City www.bricksworld.com 
 Playhao: High-quality toys for kids
 Image credit: Playhao via Facebook 
 If you’re anything like us and have ever walked past this toy shop in Forum, chances are your little one has run right in to explore the many hands-on toys invitingly laid out for experimentation. We particularly like their emphasis on building, blocks, and tech. From MAGNA Tiles to sensory toys for little ones and STEM toys for older kids, you’ll find something for every child.
 Playhao, 583 Orchard Road, #02-15 Forum The Shopping Mall, Singapore 238884, www.playhao.com 
 KEKA Toys: Non-toxic, open-ended toys
 Image credit: KEKA Toys via Instagram 
 We’re big fans of open-ended play and toys that encourage it! KEKA Toys is a family-run business curating high-quality, sustainable, and non-toxic open-ended toys for kids. Their range of toys is carefully selected and of the highest quality, all made with non-toxic colouring and eco-friendly wood. We love the gorgeous colours that are sure to catch your little one’s eye and keep them engaged for a while. With KEKA Toys, the sky is the limit!
 KEKA Toys, www.kekatoys.com 
 Kiddy Palace: Popular toy store with baby gear
 Image credit: Kiddy Palace 
 Kiddy Palace is every kid’s toy wonderland, located conveniently in heartland malls all around Singapore! This toy shop in Singapore stocks baby and kiddo essentials too, from feeding accessories to strollers, play mats and more.
 Kiddy Palace, multiple locations in Singapore including Woodlands, Marina Square, Tampines and more, www.kiddypalace.com.sg 
 Read more: Kid-Friendly Shopping Malls In Singapore 
 The Little Showcase: Toys from all over the world
 Image credit: The Little Showcase via Instagram 
 A mama-owned business that began when they sought to bring their favourite hard-to-find toys from around the world to Singapore, The Children’s Showcase has become the destination for cool and quirky toys, one-of-a-kind outfits, and oh-so-stylish kids’ décor and furniture. This toy shop stocks mermaid gear, cute party plates and sweet (non-plastic-y) toys for younger kids. They even sell party supplies, home decor and back-to-school accessories for kids.
 The Little Showcase, Tanglin Mall, 163 Tanglin Road, #02-139/141, Singapore 247933, www.instagram.com/thelittleshowcase 
 Action City: Collectible toys
 Image credit: ActionCity via Facebook 
 If you’ve got older children who love collecting figurines, Action City is an interesting pit stop that sells an unusual mix of toys for big kids and adults alike. Here, you’ll find figurines of popular characters from their favourite movies, and you can also get your hands on electronic gadgets and accessories here.
 Action City, multiple locations in Singapore including Bugis, Orchard, and Harbourfront, www.actioncity.com.sg 
 TOYSTER: Wooden toys & role playing toys
 Image credit: Toyster via Facebook 
 TOYSTER Singapore is a toy shop in Singapore with a wide range of toys for kids of all ages. Their cute wooden toys are perfect for little ones who love to role play as a chef or a baker. Older kids will love their action figures, craft activities and educational toys. They also offer plenty of Hasbro’s board games that make for a fun way to bond with the kids without the TV!
 TOYSTER Singapore, 18 Boon Lay Way, Tradehub 21, #08-135, East Lobby, Singapore 609966 (walk-ins only on Friday & Saturday), www.toyster.sg 
 Mothercare: Toys for babies and toddlers
 Image credit: Mothercare Singapore via Facebook 
 Mothercare needs no introduction since it’s one of the first stops for expecting and new mamas. Though they have a wide range of clothing for babies to toddlers, they also carry educational toys that little ones will love – think play dough, sensory toys, Melissa & Doug puzzles and more! Plus, keep a lookout for their sales throughout the year to find a deal!
 Mothercare,  multiple locations in Singapore including Yishun, Orchard, Bukit Timah and more, www.mothercare.com.sg 
 Read more: Best Baby Shops In Singapore 
 KYDZ: Open-ended toys & Montessori aids
 Image credit: KYZDZ 
 From education STEM toys like a Robot Factory Building Set to Sensory Trio Fidget Tubes for little ones, KYDZ offers a wide range of toys for kids of all ages. Best of all, these toys make learning fun! You’ll find high quality educational toys that you can’t pick up in any typical toy shop in Singapore.
 KYDZ, 3791 Jalan Bukit Merah, #01-01/02, E-Centre@Redhill, Singapore 159471, www.kydzedu.com 
 LittleShop: Fidget toys & STEM toys
 Image credit: LittleShop via Instagram 
 LittleShop carries a range of unique, high-quality European and American toys with the aim of promoting parent-child bonding, fun STEM learning, and appreciation of nature. This toy shop in Singapore also carries a range of toys for children with special needs. From sensory toys to adaptive equipment and more, their range of toys caters to kids with autism, ADHD, sensory processing disorder and more.
 LittleShop, 21 Bukit Batok Crescent, #25-77, Singapore 658065 (visit by appointment only), www.mylittleshop.co 
 Pupsik Singapore: Baby gear & toys for kids
 Image credit: Pupsik Singapore via Facebook 
 Though Pupsik is more popular for its wide selection of baby gear, it also offers toys, kids clothes and books. At this baby shop in Singapore , there are bath toys, building toys, and pretend play toys to get your little one’s imagination going. Looking for a specific brand? This online toy shop in Singapore retails popular toy brands like Melissa & Doug, Fisher Price, Jellycat, Globber and more.
 Pupsik Singapore, www.pupsik.sg 
 Read more: Where To Get Adorable Kids Clothes & Baby Clothes In Singapore 
 Amazon.sg: Online toy shop
 Image credit: Amazon.sg 
 Amazon.sg not only stocks every life essential (and non-essential) but also offers a variety of kids’ toys – they even have a dedicated toys page! As always, they have a number of great, trusted brands with toys to suit every age group. Shop by age or category to find what you need within minutes. The free local delivery and free international delivery on eligible orders is a bonus, too!
 Amazon, www.amazon.sg 
 Get Hacking: Online toy shop for tinkerers
 Image credit: Get Hacking via Instagram 
 Get Hacking has everything you need for curious little tinkers. What’s a better way to spark an interest in coding and robotics than picking up an arcade game kit? From a micro:bit Tinker Kit to littleBits Electronic Music Inventor Kit, this unique educational tech shop has a range of kits to get your older kids interested in coding and robotics. With over 30 brands to choose from, you’ll likely find what you need to suit your child’s interests. Plus, there’s free shipping for orders over $50!
 Get Hacking, 59 Jalan Pemimpin, L&Y Building, #04-01, Singapore 577218, www.gethacking.com 
 Being Kids: High-quality plush toys from around the world
 Image credit: Being Kids via Facebook 
 Got a kid who just can’t get enough of the zoo? Then Being Kids (formerly known as Natures Collection) is your next port of call. This toy shop in Singapore offers a massive selection of cute and cuddly soft toys set to turn your home into a veritable menagerie. These guys also sell animal figurines, jigsaw puzzles, educational games, and natural wooden toys for kids up to 6 years of age and beyond!
 Being Kids, 994 Bendemeer Rd, #07-04, Singapore 339943 , www.beingkids.sg 
 Simply Toys: Marvel & DC comics collectibles
 Image credit: Simply Toys via Facebook 
 Similar to Action City, Simply Toys is the toy shop in Singapore to head to for action figurines, all-time favourite characters and superheroes from Marvel, DC Comics, Disney and Star Wars movies. So if you have a Marvel fan at home, head on over to this toy shop to pick up a gift they will love!
 Simply Toys, multiple  locations in Singapore including Orchard, Dhoby Ghaut and Eunos, www.simplytoys.sg 
 T for Toys: Affordable toys for kids of all ages
 Image credit: T For Toys via Facebook 
 Toys can be expensive! That’s why the founders of T for Toys decided to start a toy shop in Singapore with affordable toys for kids who always love bouncing from one thing to the next. Whether it’s wooden building blocks for younger tots or games for a family game night, there are plenty of fun toys to choose from!
 T for Toys,  18 Tampines Industrial Crescent, #01-02A, Space @ Tampines, Singapore 528605, www.tfortoys.com 
 TOYTAG: Fun, educational toys & games
 Image credit: TOY TAG via Instagram 
 Want to make learning fun for your kids? TOYTAG carries a wide range of educational toys and games that will make learning a blast. From toddlers to young kids, they carry a range of STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics) toys that can keep your kid educationally entertained for hours! They also offer a range of tabletop games for a fun family bonding activity!
 TOYTAG, 201 Henderson Road, #06-02/03, Apex @ Henderson, Singapore 159545, www.toytag.com 
 White & Black Trading: Toys for outdoor fun
 Image credit: White & Black Trading via Facebook 
 Founded in 2007 by British mamas Justinna and Emma, White & Black Trading is the trusted toy store for toys that promise quality outdoor fun. They’re the top Singapore distributor for Micro Scooters, Penny Skateboards, Waboba, Ezyroller, Swingball tennis, Crazy Catch football nets, and QuickPlay–all brands that support the founders’ mission to keeping kids and kids-at-heart active!
 White & Black Trading , 102E Pasir Panjang Road #07-02 Citilink Warehouse Complex. Singapore 118529, www.whiteandblacktrading.com 
 Little Bearnie: High quality teether for babies
 Image credit: Little Bearnie via Instagram 
 Whether it’s teethers, baby swaddles, bibs, or baby gift bundles you’re after, Little Bearnie has got you covered. They’re also the exclusive distributor for Loulou Lollipop products–a range of super-cute BPA-free baby teething accessories! Little Bearnie products can also be found in Mothercare, Nichebabies, Tadbebe, and Bumwear.
 Little Bearnie, Blk 1016 Geylang East Ave 3, #03-171, Singapore 389731, www.littlebearnie.com 
 Toymana: Toy shop with action figures
 Image credit: Toymana via Facebook 
 Does your child enjoy collecting figurines? Check out Toymana, an online toy shop in Singapore that stocks toys and figurines for kids and the young-at-heart. Apart from figurines such as Gundam, they also sell nerf guns and Beyblade toys. They offer free local delivery with every $49 spend in a single order.
 Toymana, www.toymana.com 
 Let’s Play: Tomica & Pla-Rail toy shop
 Image credit: Let’s Play via Facebook 
 Zip on over to Singapore’s first-ever Tomica and Pla-Rail toy shop in Singapore and stock up on action figures, toy cars, model kits, and train sets–nearly all hailing from Japan. Let’s Play is perfect for youngsters who enjoy building and crafting their own toys.
 Let’s Play, 91 Bencoolen Street, #01-86 Sunshine Plaza, Singapore 289652, www.facebook.com/letsplaysgshop 
 The Entertainer Toy Shop: Educational toys & soft plushies (closed)
 Image credit: The Entertainer Toy Shop SG via Facebook 
 The Entertainer Toy Shop is one you can’t miss in a mall. Their vibrant colours and shelves are filled with a wide range of toys for little ones from newborns to older kids. The Entertainer Toy Shop also stocks board games, card games and plenty of plushies for those who love cuddling soft toys!
 The Entertainer Toy Shop, two locations in Yishun and Sengkang, www.theentertainer.com.sg 
 Little Llama: Toys for kids aged 0 to 7 (closed)
 Image credit: Little Llama via Facebook 
 This Singapore-based online toy shop quickly caught our eye as the exclusive distributor of award-winning Swiss toy designer MOLUK (be sure to check out the innovative “ Bilibo “, named 2010 toy of the year!). The Little Llama toy shop is all about encouraging child-directed, open-ended play through expert-recommended books and toys to support early learning and discovery.
 Little Llama, www.littlellama.sg 
 My Little Shoppers: VTech & FisherPrice Toys (closed)
 Image credit: My Little Shoppers via Facebook 
 Avoid the shopping crowds and let your fingers do the walking instead at this local online toy store in Singapore. Home to an impressive selection of early learning toys, you’ll find brands like Fisher Price, Leapfrog, and VTech. We especially love that you can shop the website by age group, brand or toy category helping you find exactly  what you want.
 My Little Shoppers, www.mylittleshoppers.com 
 Tickle Your Senses: Sensory play kits & toys (closed)
 Image credit: Tickle Your Senses via Instagram 
 Looking for sensory play toys or educational toys for older kids? Tickle Your Senses was founded by sensory play specialists, local mamas who are trained educators who want to share their love for children and play. From play dough to water beads, rainbow rice and magnetic tiles, you’ll find the perfect sensory toy that will keep your little one occupied for hours!
 Tickle Your Senses,  www.tickleyoursenses.sg
